title: Phreesia Named to TIME’s 2026 List of the World’s Top HealthTech Companies
summary: Phreesia, a leader in patient intake, outreach and activation, has been named to TIME’s list of the World’s Top HealthTech Companies of 2026.

-
-

**ALL-REMOTE COMPANY/WILMINGTON, Del. — Sept. 30, 2026 —** Phreesia, a leader in patient intake, outreach and activation, has been named to TIME’s list of the[World’s Top HealthTech Companies of 2026 (this link opens in new window)](https://time.com/article/2026/09/16/worlds-top-healthtech-companies-2026/) . This marks the second consecutive year Phreesia has been recognized on the list, which is developed in partnership with Statista to identify companies using technology to make healthcare more effective and accessible.


The 2026 list recognizes companies worldwide across six health technology market segments. Organizations were evaluated on financial performance, reputation and online engagement, according to[TIME and Statista’s methodology (this link opens in new window)](https://time.com/article/2026/09/16/worlds-top-healthtech-companies-2026-methodology/) . Phreesia earned a “Very High” performance rating in the Health Information & Management category.


“We’re honored to be recognized by *TIME* for a second year,” said Chaim Indig, CEO and co-founder of Phreesia. “With Phreesia supporting 1 in 6 patient visits across the U.S., we have a tremendous opportunity to help patients take an active role in their care. That scale also gives us valuable insight into the challenges patients and providers face, enabling us to focus our solutions on the problems that matter most.”


Phreesia’s digital tools help healthcare organizations connect with patients before, during and after their visits by simplifying intake and payments, sharing relevant education and prompting patients to seek needed care. For more information on Phreesia, visit[phreesia.com](https://www.phreesia.com/) .


## About Phreesia


Phreesia is the trusted leader in patient activation, giving healthcare providers, life sciences companies and other organizations tools to help patients take a more active role in their care. Founded in 2005, Phreesia enabled approximately 180 million patient visits in 2025—1 in 6 visits across the U.S.—scale that we believe allows us to make meaningful impact. Offering patient-driven digital solutions for intake, outreach, education and more, Phreesia enhances the patient experience, drives efficiency and improves healthcare outcomes. To learn more, visit phreesia.com.
